name: Defensive Scales
body:
Your scales provide you a measure of protection against all blows.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic scales or adamantine scales racial trait, character level 3rd.

Benefit: You gain DR 3/magic.

Special: If you possess the adamantine scales racial trait, this DR is increased by 2.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
